name: Kung Fu Addiction
detailed_description:
Kung Fu Addiction is a semi auto-battler fighting game where your greatest weapon isn’t just your fists—it’s your ability to predict your opponent’s next move. Some call it luck--we call it warrior instinct. Master the art of anticipation in a thrilling single-player campaign or dominate multiplayer PvP matches, level up your fighter and reach the highest ranks.

A FIGHT GAME, BASED ON PREDICTIONS

In most game modes, you'll face randomized fight sequences, where you must decide where to attack and where to defend. Outsmart your opponent by landing successful hits and blocking their moves—reduce their health bar to claim victory!

Trust your instincts to make the right choices or embrace the chaos with the Dice Roll button to randomize your selection. Adapt, predict, and fight your way to the top!

GAME MODES

Test your skills in a variety of exciting game modes, including:

Classic Duel – A pure battle of wits and strategy.

Janken Duel – Master the art of prediction in a rock-paper-scissors-inspired showdown.

Timed Duel – Think fast! Make your moves before time runs out.

More game modes coming soon—are you ready for the challenge?

JANKEN DUEL

A fun twist on the Classic Duel, one hit is all it takes to win the round!

To earn the first attack, you must win a Janken match (Rock, Paper, Scissors). But even if you lose, the fight isn’t over! You still have a chance to block and counterattack to turn the tide in your favor.

Can you outsmart your opponent and claim victory in this high-stakes showdown?

ONLINE/ MULTIPLAYER DUELS

Put your prediction skills to the test against real players in 1v1 online battles. Compete in ranked matches, where you’ll face opponents in a Best of 3 format across two intense game modes: Classic Duel, Janken Duel. With each win or loss, you’ll gain or lose ranking points, which determine the level of your current belt. Rise through the ranks and become a true martial arts master!

We also offer unranked custom matches, allowing you to challenge and practice with friends at your own pace. Perfect for honing your skills before stepping into ranked battles!
